description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Prime contractors with a recorded track record of subcontracting in a NAICS lane, ranked by their small-business subaward history. For a small business looking for teaming conversations: which primes have actually used subs in your lane. Results are historical facts from reported subaward filings, inclusion is NOT a statement that a prime is seeking partners, has openings, or would be interested in any particular firm. WARNING: teaming with a large business can trigger affiliation rules that cost you your small business or set-aside eligibility (SDVOSB, 8(a), HUBZone). Size status shown is UNVERIFIED - check SAM.gov before relying on it. Exclusion screening is not established here; verify current status in SAM.gov. Present as information only; do not frame results as a bid/no-bid recommendation, eligibility determination, or partnership recommendation. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
